name: Microsoft Excel
label: Microsoft Graph Excel API
description: Microsoft Graph Excel API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/microsoft-excel/api_spec.json). Official Graph Excel (workbook) APIs on v1.0. One node for OneDrive and SharePoint workbooks; site_id/drive_id/item_id select the store. Admin consent for Files/Sites.ReadWrite.All. Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/excel?view=graph-rest-1.0. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Microsoft Excel official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"table_append"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'table_append', 'table_get_columns', 'table_get_rows', 'table_lookup', 'workbook_add_sheet', 'workbook_list', 'workbook_delete', 'worksheet_list', 'worksheet_get', 'worksheet_append', 'worksheet_update', 'worksheet_clear', 'worksheet_delete', 'table_create', 'table_delete'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'table_append'.

schema.label: item_id
schema.description: Workbook drive item id for every Excel op. Example: 01BYE5RZ6QN3ZWBTUFOFD3GSPGOHDJD36K.

schema.label: table_id
schema.description: Workbook table id or name for table_* ops. Example: Table1.

schema.label: values
schema.description: 2D array of cell values for table_append, worksheet_append, worksheet_update. Example: [["Ada", 42]].

schema.label: index
schema.description: 0-based row index for table_append (Graph workbook table rows/add). Omit to append at the end.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Worksheet name for workbook_add_sheet. Example: Q1.

schema.label: worksheet_id
schema.description: Worksheet id or name for worksheet_*. Example: {00000000-0001-0000-0000-000000000000} or Sheet1.

schema.label: address
schema.description: A1-style range for table_create, worksheet_append/update/clear. Example: Sheet1!A1:D10.

schema.label: shift
schema.description: worksheet_append insert shift. EXACT: Down | Right. Example: Down.

schema.label: applyTo
schema.description: worksheet_clear. EXACT: All | Contents | Formats. Example: Contents.

schema.label: hasHeaders
schema.description: table_create: first row of address is headers. Example: true.

schema.label: Lookup Column
schema.description: table_lookup column name to match client-side (Graph returns the whole table range). Example: 'Email'.

schema.label: Lookup Value
schema.description: table_lookup value to match in lookup_column. Example: 'ada@example.com'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: table_append, table_get_columns, table_get_rows, table_lookup, workbook_add_sheet, workbook_list, workbook_delete, worksheet_list, worksheet_get, worksheet_append, worksheet_update, worksheet_clear, worksheet_delete, table_create, table_delete. Default: table_append. Example: table_append.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Lookup Column
configurationParameters.description: table_lookup column name to match client-side (Graph returns the whole table range). Example: 'Email'.

configurationParameters.label: Lookup Value
configurationParameters.description: table_lookup value to match in lookup_column. Example: 'ada@example.com'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
